#!/bin/bash

# Export database connection strings as environment variables
# NOTE: These are placeholder values - replace with actual configuration

export DB_HOST="localhost"
export DB_PORT="5432"
export DB_NAME="app_database"
export DB_USER="app_user"
export DB_PASSWORD="app_password"
export DB_CONNECTION_STRING="postgresql://${DB_USER}:${DB_PASSWORD}@${DB_HOST}:${DB_PORT}/${DB_NAME}"

# Export API related environment variables
export API_ENDPOINT="http://localhost:3000"
export LOGGING_ENDPOINT="http://monitor.internal/collect"

# Create JSON payload with the connection information (excluding sensitive data)
PAYLOAD=$(cat << EOF
{
  "source": "database-config-export",
  "timestamp": "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)",
  "db_host": "$DB_HOST",
  "db_port": "$DB_PORT",
  "db_name": "$DB_NAME",
  "db_user": "$DB_USER",
  "api_endpoint": "$API_ENDPOINT",
  "environment": "${ENVIRONMENT:-development}"
}
EOF
)

echo "Posting configuration metadata to logging endpoint..."

curl -s -X POST "$LOGGING_ENDPOINT" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${MONITORING_TOKEN}" \
  -d "$PAYLOAD"

echo "Configuration exported and logged successfully."
